initial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a THREE-VIEW ORTHOGRAPHIC CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET for 3D modeling.
Input image: the user-selected cream-colored BASIC EYELESS grub concept. This precise supplied image is the approved shape reference. Preserve its design, not a redesign.
Primary request: draw the SAME grub in exactly three orthographic views, left to right FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, REAR. These are the same one creature, not three concepts. FRONT looks directly into the muzzle, RIGHT SIDE is an exact 90-degree side profile with the head facing LEFT and rear RIGHT, REAR looks straight at its back end. NO three-quarter views, NO perspective, NO visible top surfaces due to camera tilt. Parallel projection only, camera level, same world scale and SAME body height in all three panels, common flat ground baseline. Front and rear must have matching body width. Side body length about 2.1 times its height, front width about 1.35 times height. This relative proportion is a sensible modeling interpretation of the reference, not a new bulky character. Display side view slightly wider than the front/rear because it represents length.
Locked design:
- ONE continuous low, soft, cream/ivory dome mound body. Rounded arch, a mostly flat belly flush to ground, subtly blunt tapered rear. Exact economical simplicity of approved reference.
- TWO broad muted warm-beige transverse bands wrap over the body from side to side. These are color bands / soft shallow segmentation, not separate armored plates and not multiple swollen balls. Show their placement consistently in the side view; use physically correct visibility in front/rear, not arbitrary stripes in every panel.
- A SMALL eyeless gray-beige recessed head disk under the front opening, about 40 percent of full front width and about half body height, framed by a simple muted beige arch lip continuous with the body. Keep front head modest and tucked low. No ears or cheek bulges.
- A tiny dark brown paired blunt downward V / chevron mouthpart in front, as in approved reference, no fangs or teeth. It is modest, not enormous mandibles or a huge mouth. Front view clearly displays this simple mouthpart, exact side projects it only slightly in front of muzzle, REAR hides it completely.
- Rear is a simple closed rounded cream end, no face, holes, extra appendages or decorative symbols.
- Absolutely NO EYES, eye dots, sockets or eyelids anywhere. NO antennae, feelers, arms, legs, feet, spikes, hairs, extra spots, tail ball, accessories or floor pedestal.
Rendering: clean high-resolution edges, very simple flat cartoon paint with a cream base and muted beige bands, few broad shadow shapes, subtle tiny painted highlights. Match reference's design and color, not the blur of its source image. NOT realistic, not glossy 3D toy, no strong thick outline, no texture noise. Neutral flat medium charcoal-gray background. Subtle simple contact shadow only, avoid hiding silhouette.
Sheet layout: wide landscape modeling sheet with three generously separated views in one row, all fully inside margins. Small clean off-white uppercase headings ABOVE each corresponding view, exact text: "FRONT", "RIGHT SIDE", "REAR". One thin muted horizontal alignment baseline beneath the three bodies. No other writing, dimensions, numbers, arrows, extra inserts, fourth view, scene props or watermark.
Prioritize cross-view consistency and accurate simple silhouette.
correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: supplied three-view cream grub sheet. Keep its creature identity, extreme simplicity, cream/beige/gray/brown palette, three-panel layout, labels FRONT / RIGHT SIDE / REAR, background, baseline, and aligned overall body heights. Correct the modeling projection defects below. This is a technical turnaround correction, NOT a redesign.
CRITICAL CORRECTION 1 — CENTER RIGHT SIDE: currently it is a 3/4 view. REPLACE with an EXACT TRUE SIDE ORTHOGRAPHIC PROFILE, camera exactly perpendicular to the animal's long axis. Front points LEFT, rear RIGHT. It must look like a low elongated dome seen purely from the side. You cannot see any frontal face disk or the face opening! The gray-beige muzzle appears ONLY as a SHORT SMALL SIDEWALL at the low front, with a thin front edge; NO ellipse, NO semicircular frontal arch, NO concentric U shapes. The brown paired mouthparts overlap in side projection into ONE tiny blunt dark-brown downward wedge at the front underside; NO visible M-shaped frontal mouth in this view. Show the two broad transverse beige color bands as strips crossing the side silhouette from top to belly. Keep smooth flat belly and rounded tapered rear, one continuous soft body. Same height as other panels, length roughly 2.4 times height.
CRITICAL CORRECTION 2 — BAND GEOMETRY IN OTHER VIEWS: bands encircle cross sections at two positions along the front-to-back body length, they are NOT longitudinal stripes. FRONT is straight on: remove the two vertical beige ribbons running down the left and right sides. The cream front cap mostly occludes bands; at most a broad concentric arc around the upper dome where the middle bulge rises behind it, never two vertical decorative stripes. Keep small central recessed gray face arch and tiny blunt paired brown mouth, exactly eyeless. REAR straight on is a CLOSED SIMPLE CREAM ROUNDED CAP, NO face and NO visible stripe ribbons, because the cream rear cap hides the bands. Front and rear body widths remain identical. Keep all three views at same scale and height, no perspective.
Keep shadows minimal and high-resolution boundaries clean. Absolutely no eyes, eyelids, eye sockets, antennae, feet, legs, spikes, teeth, tail protrusions or added decoration. No extra labels or panels. Reference has a flat, plain shape: preserve it.
